answer_2.quote: We measure the Information Gain (IG) derived from introspection... IG = H(A|Q) - H(A|Q, K). We also use the prediction entropy of the generated knowledge as a proxy for the model's confidence.

answer_3.quote: For each generated knowledge statement, we employ Deepseek-V3 (DeepSeek-AI, 2024) to assign a numerical score for both factual correctness and relevance according to the criteria provided in the prompts below.
